scope: Actual mountSelectorTools module and extracted actual daily insertion/selector construction source run over neutral in-memory DOM objects. No browser, API, widget, workflow, source or data writes. Only this test and receipt are evidence files.

tests.name: no-target hides row and disables picker and six native entries
positive target restores row with only positive option and six enabled entries
negative selection disables all six entries and direct callback refuses open
target picker synchronizes positive selection once without recursion
pending native opening locks controls and rejects duplicate callback
targets removed during open remain hidden and disabled after completion
negative-only hides row; restored positive target re-enables entries without widget writes
300 stable refresh calls cause zero hidden or hint mutations; each real transition updates once
actual CSSOM has matching important hidden guards and no competing important flex declarations
daily no-source hides prompt actions, builds no selectors, and browses library
daily negative-only retains negative library target and builds no positive selectors
daily positive-and-negative creates six entries all routed to positive source
daily positive source without textarea creates no selector entries

limits: jsdom computed style ignores earlier !important display in the control case; hidden verification here checks actual matching CSSOM declarations and DOM hidden state only. Real-browser rendered hiding belongs to root browser acceptance.
Native dynamic imports and model generation were not executed. Opening callbacks are controlled promises.
Daily test uses the actual extracted changed block with neutral host objects; it does not certify the entire createDailyControls lifecycle.
